parameters.name: Audience
parameters.description: The intended holder (consumer) of the token. If you access the DSW page through a self-built web application, set Audience to ThirdParty.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. For information about how to obtain the instance ID, see [ListInstances](~~470439~~).

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the issued token. Valid values:

* Access: used to access the DSW instance and perform operations. This type grants operation permissions.
* View: used to share DSW instance information (such as status, configurations, and logs) in read-only mode. This type does not grant modification or control permissions and is suitable for collaborators or external viewers.
